description: gemini-bridge: one hook, and it only mints. UserPromptExpansion fires solely on a user-typed /gemini-authorize, which is the one thing the CLI cannot do for itself -- establishing that a human, not the main loop, asked for an expensive call. Enforcement lives in the CLI, not here: it is the narrower chokepoint (it also covers manual, scripted and subagent callers) and it can see the resolved attachments, which a bash command line cannot reliably be parsed for. This hook never spawns a model, never sends anything, and never blocks a prompt.
